tools.name: read_integration_best_practices
tools.title: Read Airwallex integration best practices
tools.description:
CODE GENERATION AND PAYMENT DISPUTE FLOW ONLY: This tool MUST be called before any other Airwallex tools, but ONLY when the user intent is to generate code or trigger payment dispute flow. For documentation searches, general questions, or non-code-related tasks, skip this tool and proceed directly with the appropriate tools for the task at hand.

SINGLE USE PER CONVERSATION: You MUST call this tool only ONCE per conversation. The best practices content is static and doesn't need to be re-read multiple times.

This tool reads the Airwallex integration best practices documentation that contains essential guidelines for API usage, payment handling, SDK implementation, and common pitfalls to avoid.

tools.name: search_public_docs
tools.title: Search Airwallex Product, API & SDK documentation
tools.description:
Retrieve relevant sections from the official Airwallex documentation matching the user's question.

NOTE: The required parameters is QUESTION instead of query.

USAGE STRATEGY:
  DO: For API endpoints referenced, always remember to explicitly check how to perform API authentication
  DO: For SDK methods referenced, always remember to explicitly check how to initialize the SDK

QUERY REWRITE:
  DO: Rewrite the user's text into one natural, concise, straightforward English question before calling, with a clear intent (what is, how to, or why)
  DO: Keep the substance of the user's query; do not drop topics, identifiers, or constraints they mentioned
  DON'T: Split by default — use one call unless the query has clearly different topics that one question cannot cover. Do not split related keywords on the same topic, tightly coupled parts, or near-duplicate phrasings of the same intent
  DO: Rewrite unstructured keyword pastes that are not real questions (no "?", does not start with How/What/...) into natural English questions. When keywords span different topics, rewrite into one question per topic and use multiple calls. 
    Example: "Airwallex.js getting started, installation, hosted payment page, drop-in element, embedded elements, card element list of all payment elements" → "How do I get started with and install Airwallex.js for a hosted payment page or drop-in element?" and "What are all the available embedded payment elements in Airwallex.js, including the card element?".
  DO: Use separate calls for multi-part asks (two "?", or "... and ..." linking separate questions) — one question per ask. 
    Example: "Does the Create PaymentConsent API support a metadata field? Can metadata be set on a payment consent created via the drop-in element in recurring mode?" → two calls

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT:
• DO: Always submit the question parameter in English
• DO: If the user asks in another language, translate their question to English before calling this tool
• DON'T: Pass non-English text in the question parameter

PRIVACY & SECURITY REQUIREMENTS:
• DON'T: Include PII (Personally Identifiable Information) in questions
• DON'T: Include account IDs, user IDs, email addresses, or customer data
• DON'T: Include API keys, tokens, or credentials
• DON'T: Include transaction IDs, payment references, or financial data
• DO: Use generic examples like 'how to process payments' instead of specific account details
• DO: Focus on technical concepts, API endpoints, and implementation patterns
• DO: API version information is permitted as an exception (e.g., '2023-09-30')

question.description: The question to search the documentation with. Must be written in English; translate from the user's language before calling if needed.
